works.author: Joel
works.authorNote: 13th-century Byzantine chronicler; nothing is known of him beyond this work.
works.title: Chronographia compendiaria
works.latinVerifier: Leo Allatius's Latin version (1651), printed in Migne's parallel column; scan OCR in raw/scans/pg139/
works.editions: F. Iadevaia, Ioel, Cronografia compendiaria (Messina 1979); PG text reprints Allatius

works.author: Nicetas of Maroneia
works.title: Dialogi de processione Spiritus Sancti (dial. I + fragments II–VI)
works.queueNote: PG prints Hergenröther's fragments — 'not even a third' of the work. Full Greek-only critical ed.: Bucossi & D'Amelia, CCSG 92 (2021), no translation. Dialogue I is essentially whole in PG — strong first-English candidate; work page must state the fragment situation.

works.author: Isidore of Thessalonica (Isidore Glabas)
works.title: Sermones IV in B. Mariam Virginem
works.queueNote: Four Marian sermons (Nativity, Entry, Annunciation, Dormition). Not in Daley or Cunningham anthologies. Sermon-by-sermon publishable.

works.author: John of Citrus
works.title: Responsa canonica ad Constantinum Cabasilam
works.queueNote: NOT printed in PG 139 (cols 221–222 are a cross-reference only). Text in PG 119; also Rhalles-Potles V, 403–420. Attribution debated — some responsa may be Demetrios Chomatenos. Flag before translating.
